game.name: Street Fighter III: 3rd Strike
game.frameNote: Frames are game frames at 60 fps, 1-based: startup is the first frame the hitbox (or throw box, or projectile) is out. Super Arts are timed from the end of the superfreeze. Advantage is on block, on hit and on crouching hit; KD is a knockdown.

source.name: Baston
source.author: ensabahnur
source.note: Street Fighter III: 3rd Strike frame data and hitboxes from Baston by ensabahnur, extracted from the CPS3 emulator FBA-RR (hitbox work by LennethEX, Dammit, C_cube and ComedyBlissOption; the parry column is from the old karathrow.com data). Active windows come from the per-frame hitboxes; every move links to its Baston hitbox viewer.

labels.pickClass: Pick a character to see their moves by type, or filter and sort the whole roster below.
labels.recovery: Frames from the last active frame until the move ends
